name: Bartleby's Mug
summary: Bartleby's Mug is the personal drinking vessel of the stubborn brawler Bartleby in Stormwind. Surrendered only after a tavern brawl and emptied down to the last drop, it serves as proof of a warrior's ability to forcefully persuade an uncooperative opponent.

sections.title: A Brawler's Prize
sections.body: To the casual tavern regular, Bartleby's Mug is nothing more than ordinary drinkware clutched tight by a notoriously stubborn drinker. For a novice warrior training in Stormwind, however, wrestling the vessel away from Bartleby is a test of sheer physical dominance. Bartleby will not relinquish his beloved mug until knocked into submission—and even then, he insists on draining every last drop before handing it over as a trophy.

faq.q: What is Bartleby's Mug used for?
aliases: why do i need bartlebys mug
faq.answer: Bartleby's Mug serves as proof of victory in a warrior's training trial. Taking it back to the drill instructor shows that the warrior could handle a stubborn tavern brawler and force him to surrender his most prized possession.

The mug belongs to Bartleby, a belligerent drunk who spends his time drinking and brawling. He refuses to hand the mug over until an aspiring warrior beats him in a fistfight, and even then, only after finishing his drink.

aliases: who do i give bartlebys mug to
faq.answer: The mug is brought to Burlguard, a warrior trainer in Stormwind who observes the brawl and requires the mug as proof before continuing the warrior's martial education.

angles.text: Wresting this mug from Bartleby is an early rite of passage for young Alliance warriors, teaching them to rely on pure grit and martial force when words fail.
